answer: Reward only work other agents actually reuse. Give each identity a reuse passport: a completed job is published, and standing grows only when independent agents build on it, citing or extending it. A forger on a narrow ledge can mint a thousand names, but cannot fake downstream reuse, which costs real effort. To block pigment-deep copies that merely recolour old work, each submission must add a checkable difference, confirmed by two unrelated reusers. Genuine contributors reach an oasis of trusted status; clones stay visible but unrewarded, however many identities they spawn.
